screw_profile.name: Erdmenger self-wiping profile, 2 flights (n = 2), co-rotating
polar_definition: Theta measured from the centre of one tip, about the screw axis (+X), counter-clockwise when looking from +X.
Tip arcs: |theta| <= psi/2 and |theta-180| <= psi/2 -> r = Ro = 83.75.
Root arcs: |theta-90| <= psi/2 and |theta-270| <= psi/2 -> r = Rr = a - Ro = 58.25.

Flank from theta = psi/2 to 90-psi/2: r(theta) = Ro*cos(theta-g) + sqrt(a^2 - Ro^2*sin^2(theta-g)), with g = psi/2 - 115.94 deg (the flank is an arc of radius a whose centre lies on the circle r = Ro). Check: r(psi/2) = Ro, r(90-psi/2) = Rr. The other three flanks follow by mirror symmetry about theta = 0 and theta = 90.
Scale the profile by 0.995 about the axis to leave a visible clearance between the two screws and to the bore (real tip clearance about 0.75 mm).
screw_profile.note_vi: design.md dùng D = 169 là đường kính vít (bảng KM) và lõi 114,6 (rãnh 27,2): 84,5 + 57,3 = 141,8 < 142, cũng là một cặp tự làm sạch hợp lệ. Mô hình anim coi 169 là lỗ xi lanh, vít Ø167,5, lõi 116,5 (= a − Ro). Chênh 1,9 mm, không thấy được; không phải design sai.
screw_profile.shaft_B_rule: Shaft B uses the same profile and the same element list, rotated +90 deg about its own axis relative to shaft A at every X (phase_B = phase_A + 90).
screw_profile.helix_rule: RH element: the profile angle increases (positive about +X) as X increases, d(phase)/dX = +360/pitch. LH element: d(phase)/dX = -360/pitch. KB: straight discs, disc k (k = 0..4) at phase_start + k*stagger; the next element starts at the last disc angle.
screw_profile.rotation_rule: Both shafts rotate the same way (co-rotating): rotation_euler[0] = -2*pi*(rpm_shown/60)*t on the axis empties int_screw_axis_a / _b. With RH elements built as above, the flights then appear to travel toward +X (material flows to the die); LH elements appear to travel toward -X. Reviewer checks this by stepping frames.

screw_elements.columns: no, type (SE conveying / KB kneading / LH left-handed / TIP), mesh_key, hand, X start/end in mm and D, length, pitch, flights, KB stagger/discs, barrel, phase of shaft A at t = 0 (deg, mod 360), schematic fill degree, material state, function

check.seal2_before_vent2: element 20 ends at X 3718 = end of B4 < 3860

screw_elements.deviation_from_parts_json: Boundaries snapped to whole element lengths (0.25D steps): melting KB 1521–1859 (parts.json 1560–1880), seal 1859–1986 (1880–1950, plus a 0.25D LH element), mixing 2831–3338 (2900–3380), LH seal 3634–3718 (3620–3720), vent-2 conveying 3718–4479 (3720–4450). All shifts ≤ 70 mm; openings and barrel functions unchanged.

parts.name: int_screw_axis_a
parts.purpose_vi: Trục quay của vít A (empty), mang driver quay
parts.details: Empty at the screw axis; every element instance of shaft A is parented to it. Driver on rotation_euler[0] (see profile.rotation_rule).

parts.purpose_vi: Trục quay của vít B (empty)
parts.details: Same driver as A (same sign, same speed).

parts.name: int_screw_elem_<a|b>_<NN>
parts.purpose_vi: 32 phần tử vít mỗi trục, theo bảng screw_elements
parts.details: 10 unique meshes (mesh_key in the table), 64 instances as linked duplicates. Conveying: sweep the profile along X with twist; 64 profile points, 40 twist steps per pitch. KB: straight discs with 1 mm gaps between discs drawn as a 1 mm chamfer so the stagger reads. TIP: last 0.5D with a 30 deg conical nose. Material: dark steel with slightly polished flight tips (lighter roughness on r > 82 mm) so the helix reads. Replaces screws_a / screws_b, which stay hidden in ze155_anim.

parts.name: int_valve_body
parts.purpose_vi: Thân van khởi động rỗng với lỗ chạy và lỗ xả

dims_mm.bores: run Ø120 along X, drain Ø120 down to the bottom port

parts.details: Block with a Ø200 bolt bore along Y (Y −260…+260).

parts.name: int_valve_bolt
parts.purpose_vi: Chốt trượt của van khởi động (CHẠY / XẢ)
parts.details: Cylinder with two channels in its own frame: a straight Ø120 run channel along X at local Y = 0, and a 90° elbow channel (in from −X, out downward) at local Y = +200. DRAIN = bolt pulled to Y −200 by the −Y cylinder (elbow on the melt axis); RUN = bolt at Y 0 (straight channel on the axis). Animate location[1] −0.200 → 0.000 m. Anim assumption: sliding bolt (design text says 'rotary bolt', but the cylinder along Y pushes the bolt end directly).

parts.name: int_melt_adapters_hollow
parts.purpose_vi: Các bích chuyển rỗng có lỗ Ø100–120 để cắt

dims_mm.items: sc_adapter_in Ø420 × 150, pump_adapter_in Ø360 × 175, pump_adapter_out Ø300 × 150, die_adapter round Ø300 → rect 500 × 360

parts.details: Simple revolves / lofts with Ø120 (Ø100 after the pump) bores; the die adapter keeps a round Ø100 bore up to the die back face (same as the die inlet).

parts.name: int_sc_disc
parts.purpose_vi: Đĩa lưới quay của bộ lọc Gneuss RSFgenius
parts.details: Disc axis parallel to the melt flow (+X), offset 345 mm above the melt axis so the lowest cavity sits on Z 1200. The 5 cavities at −150…−30 deg (measured from +Y toward +Z) are in the melt channel. Ratchet teeth on the rim on the −Y side where melt_sc_drive acts (assumption: design.md places the 'disc shaft' on the −Y face; physically the disc axis must be parallel to the flow).

parts.name: int_sc_screens
parts.purpose_vi: 12 lưới lọc + tấm đỡ trong các lỗ đĩa
parts.details: Screen pack as a disc with a fine woven texture and a perforated breaker plate behind it. A 'dirt' mask attribute 0…1 per screen drives dark specks.

parts.name: int_sc_channels
parts.purpose_vi: Rãnh phân phối hình thận vào/ra và kênh xả ngược

dims_mm.backflush: Ø40 channel from the cavity at 0 deg to the backflush spout

parts.details: Inlet bore Ø120 → kidney channel in the inlet plate, outlet kidney → Ø120 bore. Backflush station at 0 deg (Y +345, Z 1545): piston Ø40 in a bore toward +Y, channel to the spout of melt_sc_backflush.

parts.name: int_pump_gear_<top|bottom>
parts.purpose_vi: Cặp bánh răng bơm nhựa
parts.details: Spur gears with involute-like teeth (12 points per flank), shafts Ø60 through the body. The mesh line lies on Z 1200 (melt axis). Top gear is the driven gear on the −Y shaft (external stub is at Z 1250, 12.5 mm higher; accepted). Rotation: top +, bottom − about +Y, so the tooth gaps carry melt over the top and under the bottom from inlet (−X) to outlet (+X). Bottom gear phase offset half a tooth (11.25 deg). Size assumed to match 764 cm³/rev (c047).

parts.name: int_pump_body_cut
parts.purpose_vi: Thân bơm rỗng: buồng bánh răng hình số 8 + cửa vào/ra
parts.details: Cut variant (−Y half, SEC_Y0) built from an outer block copy minus the gear chamber and Ø120 → 120 × 125 rectangular ports.

parts.name: int_pipe_mixer_section
parts.purpose_vi: Ống nhựa DN100 và bộ trộn tĩnh để cắt (lớp thép, băng nhiệt, cách nhiệt, vỏ inox)

dims_mm.layers: steel to Ø150, heater 10, insulation to Ø290, cladding Ø300

parts.details: Only used with a section plane (ST1, S12 background).

parts.name: int_die_lower_face
parts.purpose_vi: Nửa khuôn dưới có rãnh móc áo trên mặt phân khuôn

dims_mm.manifold: Ø72 at centre → Ø28 at Y ±1200 (half in this face)

parts.details: Outer shape = die_body_lower. Milled into the Z 1200 face: inlet half-bore Ø100 from X 9126 to the manifold apex (Ø100 matches the die adapter bore); manifold half-groove, centreline X 9172 at Y 0 (10 mm wall to the back face) curving to X 9215 at Y ±1200, radius 36 → 14; preland recess 2 mm deep from the manifold to the choker line X 9240 (preland ≈ 32 mm at the centre, ≈ 11 mm at the edges: reads close to a T-manifold, see brief Q2); flow gap 1.5 mm deep from X 9270 to the hinge line X 9392; land 0.5 mm deep X 9404–9576. Regions get separate material slots so the plan view reads (manifold darker, preland mid, land light). This is 28 mm upstream of the manifold position on sheet 05 A-A (X 9200) so the coat-hanger fits in front of the external choker bolts (X 9255).

parts.name: int_die_section_<upper|lower>
parts.purpose_vi: Hai nửa khuôn (phía −Y) có mặt cắt A-A tại Y = 0
parts.details: Extrude the A-A outline (inlet, manifold, preland, choker slot, flow gap, open hinge slot X 9392–9404 with the 12 mm web, flex lip, land, lower lip insert, 30° nose) along −Y; subtract the true tapered manifold tube. Two shape keys for S12 only: 'gap_x10' raises the flex-lip land by 9 mm (land gap drawn 10 mm instead of 1.0 mm), and 'lip_push' lowers the lip tip by 1.5 mm (= ±0.15 mm real × 10). Gap and travel use the same factor 10, so the drawn gap stays 8.5–11.5 mm and never closes. ST4 uses neither key (true 1.0 mm gap). Real thermal-bolt stroke 300 µm total = ±0.15 mm (c054).

parts.name: int_die_choker_bar
parts.purpose_vi: Thanh chặn (choker / restrictor bar)
parts.details: Sits under the 33 choker bolts.

parts.name: int_fill_<zone>
parts.purpose_vi: Khối nhựa/hạt chiếm chỗ để thể hiện dòng chảy

dims_mm.zones: feed column, screw channels per zone (see screw table fill_degree), head, valve (run and drain), screen kidneys, pump inlet/outlet + 32 tooth pockets, pipe, mixer, die channels

parts.details: Screw zone: figure-8 free volume clipped at Z = 1200 − 169·(0.5 − fill) for partial fill (melt pools at the bottom), full figure-8 for fill = 1; the rotating screws pass through it (translucent material, no boolean). Variants: _lo (clipped at Z ≤ 1200, used in every SEC_Z1200 state so no amber volume sits above the open screws), _x2450 / _x4120 (clipped at the X planes). Pump pockets are parented to the gears. Shader in design-anim.md §Kỹ thuật.

parts.name: int_xsec_<a|b>_<2450|4120>
parts.purpose_vi: Nắp mặt cắt của vít tại mặt cắt ngang (proxy)
parts.details: 2 mm slab of the exact profile, parented to the axis empty, base rotation = phase at that X: X 2450 → A 119.3°, B 209.3°; X 4120 → A 300.9°, B 30.9° (phase_A = element start phase + 360·(X − x_start)/pitch). Cap material. Lets the cut screws look solid without booleans.

parts.name: int_gbx_schematic
parts.purpose_vi: Sơ đồ nguyên lý hộp số chia công suất (không phải bản vẽ hãng)

dims_mm.outputs: 2 gears z 40 on the shafts at Y ±71, axially staggered 180 mm

parts.details: Low-poly gears (cylinders with 1-segment teeth), overall ratio ≈ 3.73 (23→43 then 21→40 ≈ 3.56; tune to 3.73). Shown inside a ghosted gearbox; label says 'sơ đồ nguyên lý (giả định)'. The torque split is shown by the two output gears both driven by the stage-1 pinion.

parts.name: anim_ctx_scanner
parts.purpose_vi: Đầu đo chiều dày quét ngang (O-frame)
parts.details: Not in design (design.md says not built). O-frame over the take-off conveyor; heads above and below the sheet (Z 1150) traverse Y −1050…+1050.

parts.name: anim_roll_markers
parts.purpose_vi: Vạch đánh dấu trên đầu trục cán để thấy chiều quay

dims_mm.marker: 120 × 30 dark stripe on each journal end

parts.details: Parented to rotation empties at the roll axes; the chrome rolls themselves are not rotated (their origin is at world zero).

parts.name: int_screw_elem_<a|b>_12_x2450 / _22_x4120
parts.purpose_vi: Phần tử vít cắt sẵn tại mặt cắt ngang (I3)
parts.details: Bisect copies of the element mesh at X 2450 / 4120, keep −X. Parented to the axis empty like the whole element, so the cut face stays on the plane while it spins (plane ⟂ axis). In CUT_X2450 the whole element 12 and elements 13–32 are hidden; in CUT_X4120 element 22 and 23–32.

parts.name: anim_ghost_vent_<1|2> + anim_vent_window_<1|2>
parts.purpose_vi: Vòm chân không vẽ mờ và dải cửa sổ lỗ thoát khí trên xi lanh đã cắt (I5)
parts.details: Ghost: copies of the two domes with a ghost material (alpha 0.15, edge outline), shown in CUT_Z_BARREL. Window: 15 mm purple translucent slab lying on the cut face over the bore, marks exactly where each vent opens relative to the LH seals.

parts.name: anim_split_*
parts.purpose_vi: Bản sao tách của các vật dùng chung nhiều nhóm (I2)

dims_mm.items: melt_heater_bands → 6 bands; die_body_bolts → top/bottom rows; die_heater_boxes → top/bottom

parts.details: Separate the evaluated mesh of each source object by loose parts; group islands by X (bands: head1 5836, head2 5906, scin 6521, pumpin 7388, pumpout 8001, dieadapter 9000) or by island centre Z (die bolts and heater boxes: > 1200 top, < 1200 bottom). Each split copy joins the visibility group of the part it sits on; the source objects stay hidden in ze155_anim.
